correctness.rationale: Direct subgroup-generation arguments give Cyc(D_2n)={1} and N(D_2n)=K_n join overline(K_{n-1}). The Laplacian eigenvalues follow from the sum-zero subspaces of the clique and independent parts plus the two-dimensional quotient space. Matrix-Tree and the reciprocal-eigenvalue formula then give the exact tree count and Kirchhoff index.
